summary: Event of esv::FeatSystem (per-frame update bg3.exe+0x23919F0 -> bg3.exe+0x2CAAFE0): for an entity whose feats' muting changed, carries an entity and a list of 8-byte values collected for it.

fields.name: Target
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x2CABB80 copies *param_3 (8 bytes) to +0; the caller bg3.exe+0x2CAAFE0 passes an element of its entity list (checked with IsEntityAlive and against 0xFFC0000000000000). Reader: Toolkit esv::PassiveSystem::UpdateFeatMutings (EoCServer.dll+0x1125120) reads the 8 bytes at +0 as an entity and asserts "Invalid target entity" when it is the null handle; name from that assert.

fields.name: ProgressionEntities
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x2CABB80 allocates the array (FUN_140F3DC60(+8, src)) and copies 8-byte elements, size at +0x14; destructor bg3.exe+0x6AA2D0 frees +8 after the plain-array clear FUN_1405BD630. Toolkit UpdateFeatMutings walks +8 (count +0x14, stride 8), asserts "Invalid progression entity" on a null element and looks each one up as an entity (TryGet, then its progression/feat components); name from that assert.

second_pass: Offsets and widths were already established on Windows (creator bg3.exe+0x2CABB80, destructor bg3.exe+0x6AA2D0); the Toolkit reader esv::PassiveSystem::UpdateFeatMutings names both members through its asserts (target entity, progression entities) and shows the array elements are entity handles.
